profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer interested in developing distributed systems. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from San Jose State University.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Developing and releasing software for the ML model that automatically prices Amazon Fresh products. Implementing features to earn customers trust and drive a positive customer price perception.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: Built an easily deployable and scalable service that is expected to service hundreds of millions of requests daily. Improved scalable design skills as well as became more familiar with non-relational databases. Gained experience creating extensible code.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Large Scale Systems · Data Structures

positions.title: Software Engineer (Co-Op)
positions.description: Created a variety of web tools using Django web framework. Gained familiarity with Cisco Internet Operating System and expanded cybersecurity knowledge. Built relational databases with SQLite. Gained experience with full stack web development. sharpened skills in Python, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Development Summer Intern
positions.description: Made Java applications using various different Libraries and API’s. Further solidified understanding of many of the object oriented design topics. Became proficient in agile development methods. Further improved interpersonal skills and learned to work with different developers.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Created a virtual-reality app using the unity game engine. Applied concepts from linear algebra and calculus to simulate movements in the virtual world. Became familiar with Unity and Google Cardboard APIs. Improved interpersonal skills, and learned how to divide and conquer daunting tasks. Worked extensively in C#.
